title: isHittable
abstract: Determines if the system can compute a hit point for the element.
discussion:
DiscussionisHittable returns true if the element exists and can be clicked, tapped, or pressed at its current location. It returns false if the element doesn’t exist, is offscreen, or is covered by another element.
 isHittable only returns true if the element is already visible and hittable onscreen. It returns false for an offscreen element in a scrollable view, even if the element can be scrolled into a hittable position by calling click(), tap(), or another hit-point-related interaction method.
applicability: XCUIAutomation public XCTest API on Xcode26.5. Supports bounded visible/hittable marker guard, not attribution of the absent apphost07 hit point to a specific cause.
